places.name: Royal Observatory Greenwich
places.description: Home of the Prime Meridian and Greenwich Mean Time, within a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

history.summary: SE18 lies within Greenwich. Granted Royal Borough status in 2012 to mark the Queen's Diamond Jubilee. Home to the Prime Meridian at the Royal Observatory, from which Greenwich Mean Time takes its name, and to Maritime Greenwich, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
